free_tier_limits.correction: Self-hosting is free/open source. The free hosted offering consists of testing-oriented demo servers with no feature or device-count limits, but without reverse geocoding, email service, guaranteed quality of service, or guaranteed full history; it is not an official Traccar Cloud free plan.

description.correction: Session login uses POST /api/session with form-encoded email and password, or GET /api/session?token=USER_TOKEN. HTTP Basic and Bearer authentication are separate authorization options; the session is not created by a Basic-Auth-only login request.

notes: The current official OpenAPI is version 6.14.5 and lists the submitted demo base URL. The definite defects are the session-login description and characterization of demo servers as a cloud free plan. No current official REST request-rate limit or demo-host CORS policy was located.
